corpus: multi-repo ecosystem: mncs-index + locally available mncs-* repos
corpus_rule: **/*.mncs per repo (excluding .git/target/caches/build dirs and symlinks); survey caps: max_files_per_repo=1 (alphabetically first), per_file_bytes=8192 (0 = uncapped)
note: Survey, not census: one alphabetically-first *.mncs source per repo keeps cold real-kernel execution in-session (PRESS-010: one mncs execute subprocess per kernel call; a full 437-file census needs ~400k calls). Caps and every exclusion are recorded above; rerun with --max-files-per-repo 0 --per-file-bytes 0 for the census. One process, one shared Kernels handle (pure memoization, as in tests): the second worker count re-verifies hash convergence. Call counts are process-global, hashes are canonical. Lock revision updated post-run to the checkout the run actually executed against (0eeafdd); measured metrics untouched. The executor worktree was dirty throughout (see worktree_dirty), and the binary was rebuilt mid-session from that tree.
